quotes.text: I have seen no notification on my mac. But I have heard chimes

fields.summary: Autonomous plan run with no owner present. Investigation found that since the headless-run change (#210) run drivers start with no REX_BLOCK, so ctx.Rex is nil and rhiza's own blocked-run notice (root-record OSC 7501 with kind, title and msg) is never written anywhere; the only status Rex sees for a blocked agent tab is Claude Code's native report, which chimes on the Mac but shows no banner. Rex's program-status docs leave sounds and banners to the terminal and document no banner rules. Two questions went to the arbiter, who decided: the agent tab's own wrapper (rhiza session run) writes rhiza's blocked notice to its own terminal and a working report when the block ends, the driver writes to its own block only when it has one, and no driver, daemon or watcher tab is opened; after the fix the Mac is checked for a banner, and if it still only chimes a report for Rex upstream is drafted in the repo for the owner to file, done once drafted and pointed at in the inbox.
fields.title: Plan of the missing Mac banner for VM agent questions (autonomous)
